description:
Read open and resolved comment threads on the latest envelope session.
    Pass the envelope's document_id, not a session ID. Returns thread IDs
    (threads[].id), text, replies, resolution state, and enabled/read_only
    flags. Use a thread ID with reply_comment to add a message or with
    resolve_comment to change its resolution state. Requires envelopes:read.
name: list_comments
title: List Comments
